tasks.title: Locate Daytona Beach Class C
tasks.instructions: Enable the airspace layer and its labels. Locate Daytona Beach International Airport and select the main DAYTONA BEACH INTL Class C label.

tasks.title: Identify Daytona Beach International Airport
tasks.instructions: Enable the airports layer and its labels. Find Daytona Beach International Airport and select its DAB airport label.

tasks.title: Find the Ormond Beach Navaid
tasks.instructions: Enable the navaids layer and its labels. Locate the Ormond Beach VORTAC north of Daytona Beach and select the OMN navaid label.
